cases.mandate: the webhook of the capture with the signature verified
cases.name: capture_webhook_signature_verified
notes: the signature is verified by stripe-java Webhook.constructEvent with the HMAC-SHA256 t/v1 format
the verification secret is the signing secret that Stripe issued for the real webhook endpoint of the account, passed through SHOP_PAYMENT_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Stripe cannot deliver to a local endpoint, so the harness delivered the event itself; the signature verification is the real platform path with the real issued secret
cases.proves: the payment is captured only from a signed provider event and a forged signature is refused
